join.title: Join the lobby
join.classCodeHelp: Ask your instructor. Only players with the same code see each other.

lobby.controls: Move: WASD or arrow keys · Use doors and objects: E · Chat: Enter, Esc to leave
lobby.doorPrompt: Press E to form or join a team

chat.title: Chat
chat.nobodyNearby: Nobody is close enough to hear you. Walk up to someone.

people.title: Online ({{count}})
people.alone: Nobody else here yet. Share your class code!

team.intro: Form a team of up to {{max}} players. Every team plays its own copy of the room.
team.none: No teams are waiting at this door yet.

room.exitPrompt: Press E to leave the room
room.leaveBody: You'll go back to the lobby. Your team can keep playing without you.
room.escapedBody_one: Your team escaped in {{time}} using {{count}} hint.
room.escapedBody_other: Your team escaped in {{time}} using {{count}} hints.
room.alone: Nobody else from your team is here right now.

puzzle.locked: This is still locked. Solve first: {{list}}
puzzle.hintNote: Hints are shared with your team and count on the scoreboard.
puzzle.loadingPython: Loading Python… the first time takes a few seconds.
puzzle.timeout: Your code ran for more than {{s}} seconds and was stopped. Is there an endless loop?
puzzle.noResult: The query ran but returned no table.

av.title: Voice and video
av.aloneLobby: Walk up to someone to talk.
av.aloneRoom: Nobody else from your team has joined voice yet.
av.failed: Can't reach {{name}}'s voice or video. Your network may block it; chat still works.

errors.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser's address bar, then try again.
errors.noMic: No microphone found. You can listen, but others can't hear you.
errors.noCam: The camera isn't available. Voice still works.
errors.busy: Your microphone or camera is in use by another app.
errors.unsupported: Voice and video need a secure (https) page and a current browser.

notes.title: Team notes ({{count}})
notes.empty: Collect what you find here: codes, names, numbers. Your whole team sees these notes.

share.readOnly: You're watching {{name}}'s code live. Copy it to run or change it.
